summary: The root بطأ (bTA) describes something that is slow. The form أَبْطَأُ means "more" or "most slow," indicating a comparative or superlative degree of slowness.
lane: أَبْطَأُ ذ More, and most, slow, &c. (Meyd, &c.)

headwords.def: بطّأبِهِ [and بطّأهُ , inf. n. as below, It made him slow, tardy, dilatory, late, or backward; ] it kept him, or held him, back; or put him back, or backward. (TA.) It is said in a trad., مَنْ بَطَّأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ Him whom his evil deeds keep, or hold, back, or put back, or backward, his nobility of lineage will not profit, [or advance, or put forward, ] in the life to come, or in the world to come. (TA.) مَا بِكَ and مَا بَطَّأَ signify the same [ What made thee, or hath made thee, slow? &c.]; (S, TA;) and so مَا بَطَّأَكَ . (TA.)
